items.title: Water Main Work to Temporarily Close E. Algonquin Road & Deane Street Published on October 16, 2026 As part of the City’s 2026 Capital Improvement Program, installation of a new water main on E. Algonquin Road is scheduled to begin the week of October 19, 2026. E. Algonquin Road and Deane Street will be closed to through traffic for approximately four weeks. Motorists should plan alternate routes and follow posted detour signs. Tagged as: , Public Notices

Cumberland Station North Parking Lot Resurfacing Published on October 06, 2026 The Cumberland Station commuter parking lot at 475 Northwest Highway will undergo resurfacing this week. The lot will be closed Wednesday, October 7, and Thursday, October 8, and will reopen Friday, October 9. Tagged as: , Public Notices

DPPD Releases Video & Audio Recordings of Officer-Involved Shooting Published on September 30, 2026 On September 9, 2026, at approximately 2:32 p.m., a frantic resident of 2047 E. Touhy Avenue called 911 to request assistance from the Des Plaines Police Department because her son (Babidi) was threatening to kill her while having a bipolar manic episode. During the call, Babidi was breaking windows after the caller locked him out of the home for her safety... Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices

Des Plaines Man Charged with Two Counts of First-Degree Murder Published on August 13, 2026 Following a comprehensive, yearlong investigation involving extensive forensic analysis and coordination with the Cook County State’s Attorney’s Office, the Des Plaines Police Department announces that the following Alexander J. Hoegner has been charged with two counts of first-degree murder stemming from a shooting incident on July 23, 2025. Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices

Lee Street to Close Aug. 17–27 for Railroad Crossing Work Published on August 12, 2026 Union Pacific will replace the railroad tracks and nearby pavement at the Lee Street (U.S. 14/45) crossing in downtown Des Plaines.To complete the work, Lee Street will be closed between Ellinwood Street and Miner Street from 9 a.m. Monday, Aug. 17, through 5 p.m. Thursday, Aug. 27. Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices

Arson Determined in Harding Street Condominium Fire Published on July 23, 2026 The Des Plaines Fire Department and Des Plaines Police Department, with assistance from the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) and the Illinois State Fire Marshal’s Office, determined that the May 6, 2026, fire at 1279 Harding Street was caused by arson. Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices

Illinois Dept. of Transportation Begins Two Projects in Des Plaines Published on July 01, 2026 The Illinois Department of Transportation (IDOT) will begin two roadway improvement projects within the City of Des Plaines, impacting Graceland Avenue, Jefferson Street, Lee Street, and Mannheim Road. Tagged as: , Media Releases, Public Notices
